option.name: --ad-keyword
tip: Set the URL keyword for ad segments (regex).

option.name: --allow-hls-multi-ext-map
tip: Allow multiple #EXT-X-MAP in HLS (experimental). [default: False]

option.name: --append-url-params
tip: Append input URL params to segments. Useful for some sites. [default: False]

option.name: --auto-select
tip: Auto-select the best tracks of all types. [default: False]

option.name: --auto-subtitle-fix
tip: Auto-fix subtitles. [default: True]

option.name: --base-url
tip: Set the BaseURL.

option.name: --binary-merge
tip: Binary merge. [default: False]

option.name: --check-segments-count
tip: Check if the actual downloaded segment count matches the expected count. [default: True]

option.name: --concurrent-download
tip: Concurrently download selected audio, video, and subtitle. [default: False]

option.name: --custom-hls-iv
tip: Specify HLS decryption IV.

option.name: --custom-hls-key
tip: Specify HLS decryption key.

option.name: --custom-hls-method
tip: Specify HLS encryption method.

option.name: --custom-proxy
tip: Set the request proxy.

option.name: --custom-range
tip: Download only a portion of segments. Use --morehelp for details.

option.name: --decryption-binary-path
tip: Full path to MP4 decryption tool.

option.name: --decryption-engine
tip: Set the third-party program for decryption. [default: MP4DECRYPT]

option.name: --del-after-done
tip: Delete temporary files after completion. [default: True]

option.name: --disable-update-check
tip: Disable version update check. [default: False]

option.name: --download-retry-count
tip: Set the retry count for each segment download. [default: 3]

option.name: --drop-audio
tip: Drop audio streams matching regex. Use --morehelp for details.

option.name: --drop-subtitle
tip: Drop subtitle streams matching regex. Use --morehelp for details.

option.name: --drop-video
tip: Drop video streams matching regex. Use --morehelp for details.

option.name: --ffmpeg-binary-path
tip: Full path to ffmpeg executable.

option.name: --force-ansi-console
tip: Force the terminal to be recognized as ANSI and interactive.

option.name: --header
tip: Set specific HTTP request headers.

option.name: --http-request-timeout
tip: Set the HTTP request timeout in seconds. [default: 100]

option.name: --key
tip: Set the decryption key. Format:
--key KID1:KEY1 --key KID2:KEY2
For same key: --key KEY

option.name: --key-text-file
tip: Set the key text file for decryption.

option.name: --live-fix-vtt-by-audio
tip: Fix VTT subtitle by reading audio start time. [default: False]

option.name: --live-keep-segments
tip: Keep segments when recording live with real-time merge. [default: True]

option.name: --live-perform-as-vod
tip: Download live stream as VOD. [default: False]

option.name: --live-pipe-mux
tip: Mux live stream to TS via pipe + ffmpeg. [default: False]

option.name: --live-real-time-merge
tip: Real-time merge while recording live streams. [default: False]

option.name: --live-record-limit
tip: Set the recording duration limit.

option.name: --live-take-count
tip: Manually set the initial segment count for live recording. [default: 16]

option.name: --live-wait-time
tip: Manually set the live playlist refresh interval.

option.name: --log-file-path
tip: Set the log file path.

option.name: --log-level
tip: Set the log level. [default: INFO]

option.name: --max-speed
tip: Set speed limit (Mbps or Kbps).

option.name: --morehelp
tip: Show detailed help for a specific option.

option.name: --mp4-real-time-decryption
tip: Real-time decryption of MP4 segments. [default: False]

option.name: --mux-after-done
tip: Mux audio and video after all work is done. Use --morehelp for details.

option.name: --mux-import
tip: Import external media files during muxing. Use --morehelp for details.

option.name: --no-ansi-color
tip: Remove ANSI colors.

option.name: --no-date-info
tip: Do not write date info during muxing. [default: False]

option.name: --no-log
tip: Disable log file output. [default: False]

option.name: --save-dir
tip: Set the output directory.

option.name: --save-name
tip: Set the output file name.

option.name: --save-pattern
tip: Set the file naming pattern, supports variables:
<SaveName>, <Id>, <Codecs>, <Language>, <Resolution>, <Bandwidth>, <MediaType>, <Channels>, <FrameRate>, <VideoRange>, <GroupId>, <Ext>

option.name: --select-audio
tip: Select audio streams matching regex. Use --morehelp for details.

option.name: --select-subtitle
tip: Select subtitle streams matching regex. Use --morehelp for details.

option.name: --select-video
tip: Select video streams matching regex. Use --morehelp for details.

option.name: --skip-download
tip: Skip downloading. [default: False]

option.name: --skip-merge
tip: Skip merging segments. [default: False]

option.name: --sub-format
tip: Subtitle output format. [default: SRT]

option.name: --sub-only
tip: Only select subtitle tracks. [default: False]

option.name: --task-start-at
tip: Do not start the task before this time.

option.name: --thread-count
tip: Set the download thread count. [default: 16]

option.name: --tmp-dir
tip: Set the temporary file storage directory.

option.name: --ui-language
tip: Set the UI language.

option.name: --urlprocessor-args
tip: This string will be passed directly to the URL Processor.

option.name: --use-ffmpeg-concat-demuxer
tip: Use ffmpeg concat demuxer instead of concat protocol. [default: False]

option.name: --use-system-proxy
tip: Use the system default proxy. [default: True]

option.name: --version
tip: Show version information.

option.name: --write-meta-json
tip: Output parsed info to a JSON file. [default: True]

global_option.name: --help
tip: Show help and usage information.
